papers.title: Less Decoder is More Encoder: Geometric Representation Learning from Novel View Synthesis
papers.abstract: This paper examines the role of Novel View Synthesis (NVS) in geometric representation learning. In principle, NVS should reason about 3D scene structure, thereby enabling transferable multi-view geometric representations. Yet, existing encoder-based NVS methods yield poor representations. This is not because of a lack of supervisory signal, but rather due to inconspicuous architectural choices: \textit{spatially expressive decoders} that dilute representational capabilities of the scene encoder, and \textit{low-level pixel-space targets} that hinder feature learning. We present SNAP, a self-supervised encoder-decoder transformer that addresses both through a pose-conditioned local decoder and a latent-space reconstruction objective. SNAP is task agnostic, and we show that it is competitive with special-purpose geometry-supervised methods. SNAP also performs competitively against self-supervised representations across five tasks: visual localization, pose estimation, point correspondence, depth estimation, and robot manipulation. Remarkably, SNAP's patch features exhibit emergent viewpoint invariance that approaches heavily supervised models despite lower compute and data budgets. Under camera shifts where standard 2D representations collapse, SNAP degrades more gracefully, revealing that restricting decoder expressivity actively prevents the suppression of transferable geometric structure. https://snap-nvs.github.io
papers.summary_zh: 现有基于编码器的新视角合成方法难以学到可迁移的多视角几何表示，原因在于空间表达能力过强的解码器稀释了编码器能力，且低层像素空间目标阻碍了特征学习。本文提出SNAP，一种自监督编码器-解码器Transformer，通过姿态条件局部解码器和隐空间重建目标来解决上述问题。SNAP在视觉定位、姿态估计、点对应、深度估计和机器人操作五项任务上媲美专用几何监督方法，并展现出接近强监督模型的视角不变性，表明限制解码器表达能力可防止可迁移几何结构被抑制。
papers.summary_en: Existing encoder-based Novel View Synthesis methods yield poor transferable multi-view geometric representations, not due to weak supervision but because spatially expressive decoders dilute the encoder and low-level pixel-space targets hinder feature learning. We present SNAP, a self-supervised encoder-decoder transformer with a pose-conditioned local decoder and a latent-space reconstruction objective. SNAP is competitive with special-purpose geometry-supervised methods across five tasks—visual localization, pose estimation, point correspondence, depth estimation, and robot manipulation—and exhibits emergent viewpoint invariance approaching heavily supervised models, showing that restricting decoder expressivity prevents suppression of transferable geometric structure.
highlights_zh: 姿态条件局部解码器+隐空间重建目标
五项任务媲美几何监督方法
提升视角不变性但依赖NVS训练

papers.title: 4DCodeBench: Benchmarking Agents on Inverse Graphics of Dynamic Scenes
papers.abstract: We introduce 4DCodeBench, a benchmark for 4D inverse graphics through code generation, in which agents reconstruct dynamic scenes from video as executable graphics programs. To accomplish this, agents must translate visual observations into compact representations of scene structure and dynamics, by implementing abstractions such as physical simulations to reproduce complex behavior. To evaluate this capability, we curate a set of real-world videos and construct synthetic scenes spanning diverse physical phenomena, including deformation, fluid flow, and fracture. We perform extensive benchmarking of frontier models, finding that strong static reconstruction capabilities do not yet translate into reliable reconstruction of complex dynamics. 4DCodeBench provides a testbed for tracking progress toward agents that can interpret the dynamics of the world through code. Our benchmark is available at https://github.com/4DCodeBench/4DCodeBench
papers.summary_zh: 从视频中重建动态场景的4D逆向图形任务要求智能体将视觉观察转化为可执行的图形程序，但现有基准缺乏对此能力的系统评估。本文提出4DCodeBench基准，通过代码生成实现4D逆向图形，涵盖形变、流体、断裂等多样物理现象的真实与合成视频，并实现物理模拟等抽象。对前沿模型的广泛测试表明，强静态重建能力尚不能转化为可靠的复杂动态重建，该基准为追踪能通过代码理解世界动态的智能体提供了测试平台。
papers.summary_en: Reconstructing dynamic scenes from video as executable graphics programs, i.e., 4D inverse graphics, requires agents to translate visual observations into compact representations of structure and dynamics, yet no systematic benchmark existed. We introduce 4DCodeBench, a benchmark for 4D inverse graphics through code generation, curating real-world videos and synthetic scenes spanning deformation, fluid flow, and fracture, and requiring abstractions such as physical simulations. Extensive benchmarking of frontier models shows that strong static reconstruction capabilities do not yet translate into reliable reconstruction of complex dynamics, providing a testbed for tracking progress toward agents that interpret world dynamics through code.
highlights_zh: 首个4D逆向图形代码生成基准
静态重建强但动态重建不可靠
推动代码理解世界动态研究

papers.title: RNADyn: A Benchmark for Generating and Understanding RNA Dynamics
papers.abstract: Ribonucleic acid (RNA) functions through conformational changes that are not fully captured by static structures. However, large-scale standardized RNA dynamics data remain limited, and existing approaches typically treat trajectory generation and dynamics understanding as separate objectives. Here, we introduce RNADynBench, a standardized RNA molecular dynamics (MD) benchmark with 2585 quality-controlled 100-ns all-atom trajectories and leakage-controlled splits. Building on RNADynBench, we develop RNADynNet, a unified model for RNA dynamics learning that uses a shared backbone for both trajectory generation and dynamics fingerprint extraction from a single conformer. It combines coordinate denoising, single-frame-to-trajectory alignment, and physical grounding to connect all-atom trajectory generation with dynamics representation learning. Physical grounding improves both generated dynamics and the physical information recoverable from these fingerprints. Across both test sets, including the high-flexibility challenge set, the generated trajectories achieve RMSF correlations of 0.875 and 0.766, while single-conformer predictions show comparable agreement with MD-derived dynamics. RNADynBench and RNADynNet together establish a benchmark and unified modeling framework for generating and understanding RNA dynamics.
papers.summary_zh: RNA功能依赖构象变化，但大规模标准化RNA动力学数据稀缺，且轨迹生成与动力学理解通常被割裂研究。本文提出RNADynBench基准（含2585条质控100纳秒全原子轨迹及防泄漏划分）和统一模型RNADynNet，通过共享骨干网络结合坐标去噪、单帧到轨迹对齐与物理约束，同时实现轨迹生成与动力学指纹提取。在含高柔性挑战集的测试中，生成轨迹RMSF相关性达0.875和0.766，单构象预测与MD动力学一致，为RNA动力学生成与理解建立了基准和统一框架。
papers.summary_en: RNA function relies on conformational changes poorly captured by static structures, yet large-scale standardized RNA dynamics data are limited and trajectory generation and dynamics understanding are typically treated separately. Here we introduce RNADynBench, a standardized RNA MD benchmark with 2585 quality-controlled 100-ns all-atom trajectories and leakage-controlled splits, and RNADynNet, a unified model with a shared backbone combining coordinate denoising, single-frame-to-trajectory alignment, and physical grounding for both trajectory generation and dynamics fingerprint extraction. Generated trajectories achieve RMSF correlations of 0.875 and 0.766 including on a high-flexibility challenge set, with single-conformer predictions comparable to MD-derived dynamics, establishing a benchmark and unified framework for generating and understanding RNA dynamics.
highlights_zh: 统一生成与理解RNA动力学的共享骨干模型
RMSF相关性最高达0.875
推动RNA动力学标准化研究
highlights_en: Unified shared-backbone model for RNA dynamics generation and understanding

papers.title: From Mixing to Tearing: Graph Decomposition in Decentralized Optimization via Message Passing
papers.abstract: We study the minimization of sums of smooth strongly convex functions over undirected graphs, with each function held by one agent and communication restricted to neighbors in the graph. Existing decentralized methods, whether based on gossip or on routing over spanning trees, typically use the network to mix or aggregate information to enable {\it prescribed} local optimization updates. What this communication-centered viewpoint lacks is a general framework that uses graph structure to {\it jointly} design the optimization subproblems and the cooperative computation and communication through which agents solve them cooperatively. We develop such a framework from first principles, jointly designing the linear representation of agreement constraints, the blocks of the resulting dual variables (jointly optimized), and connected cluster of agents that cooperatively solve each block subproblem over the assigned subgraph. GATE (Graph-Tearing message passing) is a first instance of this framework: one variable per edge and tree blocks. At each iteration, agents update their assigned edge variables by minimizing the sum of the two endpoint cost-to-go messages and relaxing the result. The messages are updated through local minimizations following the tree recursion. To reduce per-iteration computational and communication costs, we develop GATE-S, a surrogate variant using tractable local models and lightweight message parametrizations. We establish linear convergence with a rate explicit in the interplay among function regularity, network topology, and the chosen partition, revealing the effects of graph decomposition. Numerical experiments are conducted to validate the theoretical results and evaluate the efficiency of our algorithms.
papers.summary_zh: 在无向图上最小化各智能体持有的光滑强凸函数之和时，现有去中心化方法仅将网络用于混合或聚合信息以支撑预设的局部优化更新。本文提出一个联合设计框架，同时设计一致性约束的线性表示、对偶变量分块及协作求解子问题的智能体簇，并给出首个实例GATE（边变量与树分块的消息传递）及其轻量变体GATE-S。理论证明线性收敛速率显式依赖于函数正则性、网络拓扑与划分方式，揭示了图分解的影响，数值实验验证了理论并展示了效率。
papers.summary_en: We study minimizing sums of smooth strongly convex functions over undirected graphs where each agent holds one function and communication is limited to neighbors. Existing decentralized methods use the network merely to mix or aggregate information for prescribed local updates; this paper develops a framework that jointly designs agreement constraints, dual variable blocks, and agent clusters solving each block, with GATE (edge variables, tree blocks) as a first instance and GATE-S as a tractable surrogate. Linear convergence is established with a rate explicitly depending on function regularity, topology, and partition, revealing graph decomposition effects, and numerical experiments validate the theory and efficiency.
highlights_zh: 联合设计优化子问题与通信的图分解框架
线性收敛率显式依赖拓扑与划分
适用于去中心化优化，但依赖强凸光滑假设

papers.title: Language Models that Play Chess and Explain Their Moves
papers.abstract: Modern chess engines are silent experts: they play at a superhuman level, but do not offer explanations for their play. On the other hand, language models (LMs) can generate plausible-sounding explanations, but their weak playing strength limits the utility of their explanations. We introduce Queen, a 4B-parameter chess-language model that can explain its moves and plans while playing at the level of a typical Grandmaster. Our novel framework enables domain-specific reasoning through complementary components: an encoder-decoder architecture and an iterative distillation algorithm. This architecture integrates a silent expert chess encoder with an instruction-tuned LM through cross-attention, which we train via a question-answering curriculum to extract chess concepts from the encoder's representations. Building on this domain-adapted model, we iteratively improve its explanations with a natural-language analog of the Bellman update: the model analyzes the positions after its top candidate moves and consolidates them into an explanation of the current position, which is then distilled back into the model. Over seven iterations, our model gains over 900 Elo points (1782 to 2697), substantially surpassing all frontier models on both playing strength and puzzle accuracy, despite containing three orders of magnitude fewer parameters. Furthermore, LM-based evaluations show that our explanations are fluent and approach GPT-5.6-Sol (high) in coherence. The generality of our architecture and training procedure suggests a recipe for applying language models to domains where silent expert encoders are available, like games, robotics, and computer use.
papers.summary_zh: 国际象棋引擎棋力超人类却无法解释走法，而语言模型虽能生成解释但棋力薄弱，二者难以兼得。本文提出Queen，一个4B参数的棋类语言模型，通过编码器-解码器架构将静默专家棋类编码器与指令微调LM经交叉注意力结合，并用迭代蒸馏算法（类比Bellman更新的自然语言版本）从候选走法后的局面分析中提炼解释并蒸馏回模型。经七轮迭代，模型Elo从1782升至2697（提升超900分），在棋力和谜题准确率上大幅超越所有前沿模型且参数量少三个数量级，其解释流畅度接近GPT-5.6-Sol（high），为游戏、机器人等存在静默专家编码器的领域提供了通用配方。
papers.summary_en: Chess engines play superhumanly but cannot explain their moves, while language models can generate plausible explanations but play weakly, limiting their usefulness. We introduce Queen, a 4B-parameter chess-language model that explains its moves and plans at Grandmaster level, using an encoder-decoder architecture that couples a silent expert chess encoder with an instruction-tuned LM via cross-attention, trained with a QA curriculum and an iterative distillation algorithm analogous to a natural-language Bellman update. Over seven iterations it gains over 900 Elo (1782 to 2697), surpassing all frontier models in playing strength and puzzle accuracy with three orders of magnitude fewer parameters, while producing fluent explanations approaching GPT-5.6-Sol (high) in coherence, suggesting a general recipe for domains with silent expert encoders such as games, robotics, and computer use.
highlights_zh: 交叉注意力耦合专家编码器与LM
Elo 1782→2697，超所有前沿模型
可推广至机器人、计算机使用等领域

papers.title: FrugalEvo: Towards Cost-Aware LLM-Guided Program Evolution
papers.abstract: LLM-guided evolutionary methods, such as AlphaEvolve, have emerged as powerful approaches for challenging computational optimization problems, such as circle packing. However, prior work typically optimizes performance gain over a fixed number of iterations. We argue that practical optimization should maximize gain per unit cost. To this end, we propose FrugalEvo, a cost-aware evolutionary framework where a stronger, higher-cost LLM explores solution strategies, and a cheaper LLM implements them and iteratively refines the resulting code. We also design a cache-efficient evolution process, where our harness and prompts maximize the sharing of prefixes across different evolution steps, to improve cache reuse. To measure solution quality throughout a fixed cost budget, we introduce Budget-Aware Area Under the Curve (BA-AUC), defined as the area under the best-so-far evaluation score curve over cumulative LLM cost, up to the budget. Across 10 mathematical and systems optimization tasks, FrugalEvo matches or surpasses state-of-the-art baselines, including OpenEvolve, ShinkaEvolve, AdaEvolve, and EvoX, in final solution quality and achieves higher BA-AUC on 9 tasks. It also achieves higher average performance than these baselines on 10 algorithmic optimization tasks from ALE-Bench-Lite. Notably, on circle packing, FrugalEvo achieves new state-of-the-art performance with GPT-5.6 Terra and Luna for only 1.68 USD and with GLM-5.3 and its Flash variant for only 0.55 USD, matching or surpassing all baselines, including multi-agent methods such as CORAL and SwarmResearch, which cost approximately 50 USD on average.
papers.summary_zh: 现有LLM引导的进化方法（如AlphaEvolve）通常以固定迭代次数优化性能，忽略了实际优化中单位成本收益的重要性。FrugalEvo提出成本感知的进化框架，用高成本强LLM探索策略、低成本LLM实现并迭代精炼代码，同时通过缓存高效的提示设计最大化前缀共享。在10个数学与系统优化任务中，FrugalEvo在9个任务上取得更高BA-AUC，并在圆填充任务上以1.68美元（GPT-5.6）和0.55美元（GLM-5.3）达到新SOTA，远低于多智能体基线约50美元的成本。
papers.summary_en: Existing LLM-guided evolutionary methods like AlphaEvolve typically optimize performance over a fixed number of iterations, ignoring the importance of gain per unit cost in practical optimization. FrugalEvo introduces a cost-aware evolutionary framework where a stronger, higher-cost LLM explores strategies while a cheaper LLM implements and iteratively refines code, combined with a cache-efficient evolution process that maximizes prefix sharing across steps. Across 10 mathematical and systems optimization tasks, FrugalEvo achieves higher BA-AUC on 9 tasks and sets new state-of-the-art on circle packing for only 1.68 USD (GPT-5.6) and 0.55 USD (GLM-5.3), far below multi-agent baselines costing about 50 USD on average.
highlights_zh: 强弱LLM分工的成本感知进化框架
圆填充SOTA仅需0.55美元
缓存高效提示设计提升复用率

papers.title: MoSE3: Learning World-Space SE(3) at Every Pixel
papers.abstract: Dense 3D point tracking has been a prominent paradigm for modeling motion in dynamic scenes, but a point track is just a 3-DoF translation curve per pixel: it captures where pixels go, not the rotation of the underlying part, nor which pixels move together as one body. We propose MoSE3, the first feed-forward model that predicts dense SE(3) motion from monocular RGB video, producing full 6-DoF rigid transforms at every pixel in world space. Per-pixel SE(3) motion offers a richer view of how a scene moves: rotation, translation, and grouping all at once. Directly predicting SE(3) is challenging: rotations lie on a curved manifold that is ill-suited to Euclidean regression, and annotations for SE(3) are particularly difficult to acquire. To address these challenges, MoSE3 predicts per-pixel SE(3) through two jointly learned intermediates, 3D point tracks and rigidity embeddings, and recovers SE(3) by differentiably fitting transforms within each soft rigid cluster, enabling end-to-end prediction and supervision. To close the data gap, we introduce Art-Kubric, a large-scale synthetic dataset with dense SE(3) and rigidity labels for articulated objects with rich physical interactions. MoSE3 achieves state-of-the-art SE(3) estimation at pixel, part, and object levels on both rigid and articulated benchmarks, and state-of-the-art average 3D point tracking accuracy across three datasets, while showing strong generalization to real-world videos despite being trained solely on synthetic motion data.
papers.summary_zh: 现有密集3D点跟踪仅提供每像素3自由度平移曲线，无法捕捉旋转和刚体分组。MoSE3首次通过前馈模型从单目RGB视频预测世界空间每像素6自由度SE(3)运动，借助3D点跟踪和刚性嵌入两个联合学习中间量，可微拟合软刚性簇内变换，并引入Art-Kubric合成数据集提供密集SE(3)标注。该方法在刚性和铰接基准上取得像素、部件和物体级SE(3)估计最优，并在三个数据集上实现最佳平均3D点跟踪精度，且从合成运动数据泛化到真实视频。
papers.summary_en: Dense 3D point tracking only provides a 3-DoF translation curve per pixel, missing rotation and rigid grouping. MoSE3 is the first feed-forward model that predicts dense 6-DoF SE(3) motion at every pixel in world space from monocular RGB video, using jointly learned 3D point tracks and rigidity embeddings with differentiable soft rigid cluster fitting, plus the Art-Kubric synthetic dataset with dense SE(3) and rigidity labels. It achieves state-of-the-art SE(3) estimation at pixel, part, and object levels on rigid and articulated benchmarks, and state-of-the-art average 3D point tracking accuracy across three datasets, generalizing to real-world videos despite training only on synthetic motion data.
highlights_zh: 首个每像素6自由度SE(3)前馈预测模型
像素/部件/物体级SE(3)估计均达SOTA
合成训练泛化真实视频，标注仍受限

papers.title: CORNAV: Construction-Aware Reasoning for Robot Navigation on Active Worksites
papers.abstract: The construction industry faces persistent labor shortages, low productivity that costs the global economy over $1.6 trillion annually, and one of the highest injury rates among major industries. These factors motivate the use of autonomous robots to improve efficiency and worker safety. Existing language-grounded navigation systems, however, rely on semantic scene understanding alone and lack access to construction-specific context such as architectural plans, evolving work schedules, and safety constraints. As a result, they localize permanent building features unreliably and cannot safely navigate active jobsites. We present CORNAV, a blueprint-grounded, schedule-aware navigation framework that operates from 2D CAD drawings and project schedules without requiring a Building Information Model. CORNAV aligns architectural blueprints against hierarchical open-vocabulary 3D scene graphs to ground object queries, converts project schedules into time-varying navigation constraints, and validates requests through an LLM-based safety module that escalates hazardous zones before planning. An A* planner then enforces mandatory exclusion zones while preferentially avoiding higher-risk areas. Across an indoor office and a real construction site, blueprint grounding raises task success from 13.0% to 72.2% over semantic retrieval alone, schedule awareness eliminates all hard-zone violations, and the safety module correctly rejects hazardous requests arising from mislabeled project schedules.
papers.summary_zh: 建筑行业面临劳动力短缺、低生产率和安全事故频发等问题，但现有语言导航系统仅依赖语义场景理解，缺乏施工图纸、进度计划和安全约束等上下文，无法在活跃工地安全导航。CORNAV提出基于蓝图的调度感知导航框架，通过将2D CAD图纸与开放词汇3D场景图对齐来定位物体，将项目进度转化为时变导航约束，并利用LLM安全模块验证请求，再由A*规划器强制执行禁入区并规避高风险区域。在室内办公室和真实工地测试中，蓝图对齐将任务成功率从13.0%提升至72.2%，调度感知消除了所有硬性区域违规，安全模块能正确拒绝因进度表错误标注而产生的危险请求。
papers.summary_en: The construction industry suffers from labor shortages, low productivity, and high injury rates, yet existing language-grounded navigation systems rely solely on semantic scene understanding and lack construction-specific context like blueprints, schedules, and safety constraints, making them unreliable and unsafe on active jobsites. CORNAV is a blueprint-grounded, schedule-aware navigation framework that aligns 2D CAD drawings with hierarchical open-vocabulary 3D scene graphs, converts project schedules into time-varying navigation constraints, and validates requests via an LLM-based safety module before A* planning enforces exclusion zones and avoids high-risk areas. Across an indoor office and a real construction site, blueprint grounding raises task success from 13.0% to 72.2% over semantic retrieval alone, schedule awareness eliminates all hard-zone violations, and the safety module correctly rejects hazardous requests from mislabeled schedules.
highlights_zh: 蓝图对齐开放词汇3D场景图
成功率从13.0%提升至72.2%
消除硬区违规，拒绝危险请求

papers.title: UniIntervene++: An Adaptive Intervention Agent for Efficient Real-World Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Online reinforcement learning (RL) enables robot policies to improve through physical interaction, but the assistance they require changes as their competence evolves. Existing intervention strategies based on offline estimates or fixed decision rules can therefore become mismatched to the current policy. To address this, we propose UniIntervene++, an adaptive intervention agent that learns to allocate control between autonomous execution and heterogeneous assisted behaviors during online RL. Specifically, UniIntervene++ first formulates the evolving RL policy, trajectory correction, and a task-structured CodePolicy as Options in a unified semi-Markov decision process and learns their relative values online. Building on this, competence-adaptive intervention periodically probes the RL policy through unassisted execution, keeping control allocation responsive to its evolving capability. Finally, coupled experience learning allows assisted behaviors to improve the RL policy, whose evolving outcomes in turn reshape future intervention decisions. In this way, UniIntervene++ jointly determines when to intervene, how to intervene, and when to return control as the RL policy improves. Across five real-world manipulation tasks, UniIntervene++ achieves an average success rate of 89.67%, outperforming all baselines by at least 6 percentage points, while reducing human intervention to 0.77%, a relative reduction of at least 94.6% from the best baseline. Code is available in our \href{https://github.com/dannyyudong/An-Adaptive-Intervention-Agent-for-Efficient-Real-World-Reinforcement-Learning}{GitHub repository}.
papers.summary_zh: 在线强化学习在真实机器人任务中需要随策略能力变化而调整的人工辅助，但现有基于离线估计或固定规则的干预策略容易与当前策略失配。UniIntervene++ 将演化中的RL策略、轨迹纠正和任务结构化CodePolicy统一建模为半马尔可夫决策过程中的Options并在线学习其相对价值，结合能力自适应干预与耦合经验学习，联合决定何时干预、如何干预及何时交还控制权。在五个真实操作任务中平均成功率达89.67%，超越所有基线至少6个百分点，同时将人工干预降至0.77%，相对最佳基线减少至少94.6%。
papers.summary_en: Online RL for real-world robots requires assistance that changes as policy competence evolves, yet existing intervention strategies based on offline estimates or fixed rules can become mismatched to the current policy. UniIntervene++ formulates the evolving RL policy, trajectory correction, and a task-structured CodePolicy as Options in a unified semi-Markov decision process, learns their relative values online, and combines competence-adaptive intervention with coupled experience learning to jointly decide when, how, and when to return control. Across five real-world manipulation tasks, it achieves an average success rate of 89.67%, outperforming all baselines by at least 6 percentage points while reducing human intervention to 0.77%, a relative reduction of at least 94.6% from the best baseline.
highlights_zh: 统一Options建模与在线价值学习
降低人工干预，提升真实部署效率

papers.title: What Should World Models Forget? Stratified Retention for Continual Adaptation
papers.abstract: Continual learning treats degradation on previously seen data as evidence of failure, a convention inherited from settings with a stationary prediction target, where a correct label remains correct indefinitely. World models do not satisfy this condition. Their prediction target is the environment, which changes, so knowledge that was accurate when acquired may later become false, and discarding it is required behavior rather than a defect. Non-stationary ground truth is well studied in the concept drift literature and in the temporal factuality of language models, but has not been formulated for world models, which are distinctive in that they also encode knowledge that must never be revised. We argue that continual world models require retention stratified by invariance timescale, separating invariants such as physics and object permanence, which must never be revised, from instance-level facts that should be revised as soon as the environment changes. Standard forgetting metrics cannot distinguish a world model that has correctly revised outdated knowledge from one that has suffered catastrophic forgetting, and consequently rank a frozen model highest, while existing physical-reasoning benchmarks evaluate only frozen checkpoints. We propose differential retention, which reports invariant regression testing across the adaptation stream jointly with revision latency, without aggregation.
